creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, sections "Phase 2: column categories", "Schema and defaults" and "CLI, API and web".

One board schema bump carries both `category` on columns and phase 3's `[ready]` table (`order`, `exclude`), so a phase-2 kan can't drop `[ready]` when it saves a board. Also: validation warnings, default categories from `kan init` and `kan board create`, `kan column add` and `kan column edit` with `--category`, categories in `kan column list` and `kan board describe`, and `BoardService` keeping `[ready] order` in step when a column is renamed or deleted.
title: Add column categories and [ready] settings to board config (board/14)
